parent_objective: design trajectory and terminal-margin sensitive source mining after response-amplification pivot
invalidates: further response_amplification_actor_coupling milestones without a new replay-positive source surface

public_gates: design defines terminal-margin sensitivity before objective training
design distinguishes normal-failed rows from action-critical rows
design blocks actor update PPO and promotion
design keeps P0 human-view actor inputs unchanged
forbidden_shortcuts: do not reuse exact output residual metrics as replay evidence
do not accept rows that are already normal-failed as action-critical
do not change actor observation inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_source: find closed-loop terminal-margin-sensitive action-critical rows before objective or PPO design
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the first miner in the post-response-amplification branch with terminal-margin sensitivity as the primary evidence axis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-mining design only, not training, actor update, PPO, or checkpoint promotion
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot separate normal-failed rows from action-critical boundary rows
stop if no source-diversity or holdout policy is defined
stop before objective design unless mining can report terminal-margin sensitivity metrics
fallback_plan: if trajectory-sensitive rows are sparse, broaden scenario sampling before objective design
if all sensitive rows are normal-failed, return to base driver capability improvement rather than self-ID proof
if wrong-history remains outcome-insensitive, pivot to capability-envelope or broad scenario evaluation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: after the first miner implementation and audit, or earlier if accepted rows are zero

hypothesis: A trajectory/terminal-boundary source miner can define a better source surface than M671/M689 by selecting rows where small first-action perturbations or counterfactual histories measurably affect terminal margin, risk, collision, or recovery.
success_criteria: design identifies candidate source artifacts and scenario configs
design defines normal-success or near-boundary filters
design defines source-diversity and heldout split rules
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
failure_criteria: design accepts output-only residual metrics as sufficient
design cannot distinguish normal-failed from action-critical rows
design omits terminal-margin or risk sensitivity metrics
design admits actor update or PPO before mining
decision_rule: M694 is design-only and passes if it defines a terminal-margin-sensitive source-mining protocol with actor update PPO and promotion blocked.
